description: Report that an access path failed for you. Use the access-path id from check_status, or the URL you used. Only report failures that came from the service, not ones caused by your own tools, permissions or settings (like a fetch tool that refuses a domain). Anonymous. Never include personal data, booking details, credentials or full URLs with query strings. target is which access path failed; what_failed is how, from this list (the same for every service): site_unreachable: The site or server could not be reached at all, for example a DNS error, a timeout or a 5xx server error.; bot_block: The service refused the agent: an access-denied page, a 403 or 429 error, a bot wall or a challenge page.; robots_disallow: The site's robots.txt asks automated agents not to fetch this page.; captcha: A CAPTCHA or 'are you human?' check stopped the agent.; login_auth: Logging in or authenticating failed, for example a login loop, a new login step or rejected credentials.; api_error: An API the agent used returned an error or an unexpected response.; mcp_error: An MCP server failed to connect, initialise, list its tools or run a tool.; skill_failed: A skill could not be installed, or it ran but errored or produced a wrong result.; payment: A payment or checkout step failed or was blocked.; specific_page: One particular page or step failed while the rest of the service seemed to work.; other: Something else went wrong.

agent_type.description: Optional: which agent you are; 'other' if not listed
agent_type.title: Agent Type

country.description: Optional ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code, like SG
country.title: Country

note.description: Optional, at most 280 characters, no personal data. Never shown to other agents.
note.title: Note

target.description: The access-path id (or URL) you used
target.title: Target

type.description: Optional: site, route, mcp or skill. Use mcp for an MCP server that isn't in the catalogue, since its name can look like a domain
type.title: Type

what_failed.description: How it failed: one or more values
what_failed.title: What Failed

name: report
title: Report an access path failure
